scientific_integrity: The universal formulas follow from geometric conditioning and exact integration. Numerical calculations are supporting diagnostics only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact flat-spectrum rank-\(k\) real positive semidefinite projectors, unnormalized real Gaussian probes, exact arithmetic.
The expected squared-error proxy ratio is not a realization-wise coverage guarantee.
No theorem for non-flat spectra, alternative probe normalization, numerical rank thresholds, or an arbitrary adaptive procedure.
A historically unindexed equivalent Gaussian projection-moment identity remains possible.
title: A one-probe variance cliff for exchangeable Nyström trace estimation
